welcome.title: Set up your research workspace
welcome.subtitle: Configure network access, reusable capabilities, and your first research task.

network.title: Choose network access
network.subtitle: Control which external research services the agent may use.

capabilities.title: Choose capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Configure the connectors, skills, and local software available to your research agent.
capabilities.externalNotice: Enabled connectors may communicate with the named external research services. Review the list before continuing.
capabilities.runtimeNotice: Python and R are required core runtimes and are managed automatically. Optional groups start unselected; choose only what you need. Preparation runs in the background and never blocks the workspace.
capabilities.unavailable: Not available to the selected first-run assistant
capabilities.noRuntimes: No local software matches your search.
capabilities.runtimeQueued: prepared in the background after setup
capabilities.runtimeUnavailable: Local scientific runtimes are unavailable on this system
capabilities.runtimePythonDescription: Required Python runtime for scientific tasks; installed once and reused from the managed environment store.
capabilities.runtimeRDescription: Required R runtime for scientific tasks; installed once and reused from the managed environment store.
capabilities.runtimeCommonDescription: RDKit, BioPython, Gemmi, and PyYAML for molecules, sequences, and PDB/mmCIF files.
capabilities.runtimeInteractionDescription: ProLIF, MDAnalysis, and CairoSVG for protein–ligand interaction diagrams and exports.
capabilities.runtimeElectrostaticsDescription: APBS, PDB2PQR, PROPKA, and RDKit for reproducible protein, pocket, and ligand potential maps.
capabilities.runtimeVinaDescription: The complete governed Vina, Meeko, Gemmi, ProDy, and BioPython docking environment.
capabilities.runtimeDrugChemistryDescription: Thermo, Chemicals, ChemPy, and ASE for physical properties, reaction engineering, and process calculations.
capabilities.runtimeConversionTitle: Molecular conversion and rapid quantum tools
capabilities.runtimeConversionDescription: Open Babel, Dimorphite-DL, xTB, and ASE for format conversion, protonation, and rapid quantum calculations.
capabilities.runtimeQSARDescription: scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, Optuna, and Mordred descriptors.
capabilities.runtimeClinicalDescription: Lifelines, Pingouin, LMFit, Pint, and OpenPyXL for survival, statistics, and PK/PD data.
capabilities.runtimeOmicsDescription: A classical CPU stack with Scanpy, AnnData, Harmony, Leiden, and igraph.
capabilities.runtimeGenomicsDescription: SAMtools, BCFtools, BEDTools, Minimap2, SeqKit, and pysam.
capabilities.runtimeSimulationDescription: MDAnalysis, MDTraj, ParmEd, and OpenMM for CPU trajectories and simulation.
capabilities.runtimeImagingDescription: pydicom, NiBabel, SimpleITK, and scikit-image for DICOM, NIfTI, and image processing.
capabilities.runtimeInstrumentDescription: Allotropy, Pandas, OpenPyXL, and PDFPlumber for instrument standardization and table extraction.
